cubes.label: Left view of a colored stack
cubes.observed: Viewed along a ray, the nearest occupied cube supplies its square color. Opposite silhouettes can coincide.
cubes.construct: Choose column heights and a marker that distinguish near from far on one ray. A same-silhouette recoloring isolates that decision; test all options against the given views.

step.label: Visible edges of a stepped CAD solid
step.observed: A ledge changes the outer or inner visible edge depending on the viewing direction.
step.construct: Orient the step and choose a given and requested view that reveal different edges. Let one foil preserve the outline but move a riser. Check the reimported solid against the drawing.

bores.label: Projection of holes in a CAD solid
bores.observed: A hole mouth is visible down the bore axis; looking across the plate can hide the opening.
bores.construct: Vary the two bore positions and radii on the plate; choose an axial target and a foil with a moved rim. Retain enough asymmetry to distinguish the projected holes.
